title: HGV Class 1 Driver
summary: Deliver fresh Mediterranean produce and grocery orders to our stores and wholesale customers across London and the South East, driving our own fleet of Class 1 (C+E) vehicles.
responsibilities: Carry out multi-drop deliveries to stores, restaurants and wholesale customers on time and in full
Carry out daily walk-around vehicle checks and report defects
Load and unload stock safely using a tail-lift and pump truck
Complete delivery paperwork and digital proof-of-delivery scans accurately
Represent Bodrum Foods professionally with customers on every drop
Follow all Working Time Directive and driver's hours regulations
requirements: Valid UK Category C+E (Class 1) driving licence with no more than 6 points
Current Driver CPC card and digital tachograph card
At least 1 year of recent HGV driving experience
Good knowledge of London and the M25 corridor
Reliable, punctual and comfortable with early starts (from 5:00am)
benefits: Paid overtime and weekend premium rates
28 days holiday (including bank holidays), rising with service
Staff discount across the Bodrum Foods range

title: Class 2 Delivery Driver
summary: Join our growing delivery fleet running local multi-drop routes to independent grocers, restaurants and Bodrum Foods stores across Greater London.
responsibilities: Plan and run efficient multi-drop delivery routes
Carry out daily vehicle checks and report any faults immediately
Handle chilled and ambient goods with care, following food-safety procedures
Build strong relationships with regular customers on your round
Use a handheld device to record deliveries and collect signatures
requirements: Valid UK Category C (Class 2) driving licence
Current Driver CPC card and digital tachograph card
Previous multi-drop delivery experience preferred
Comfortable lifting and manoeuvring goods using a pump truck
Right to work in the UK
benefits: Consistent local routes — home every night
Staff discount across the Bodrum Foods range

responsibilities: Assist the driver with loading, unloading and carrying deliveries into stores and kitchens

Help keep the delivery vehicle tidy, secure and organised through the shift
Support warehouse picking and goods-in duties on non-delivery days
Follow manual handling and health & safety procedures at all times
requirements: No experience necessary — full training provided
Physically fit and comfortable with manual lifting
Friendly, reliable and a strong team player
Right to work in the UK
A full UK driving licence is an advantage but not essential
benefits: Full training provided, with a clear route into a driving role
Staff discount across the Bodrum Foods range

Good attention to detail and a steady pace of work

At least 6 months of recent forklift experience in a warehouse environment
